result:
I've made the round-155 fix for C-R154-01: the timecode in the lane-move ghost should now render in IBM Plex Mono at weight 400 instead of 500. That is only checked in the source and the unit tests so far; C still has to confirm it in the browser.

**What changed (only the 3 files the task allows):**
- **`ArrangementLane.tsx`:** one token, `font-normal`, added to the timecode span on line 929. The ghost box still sets `font-medium`, so the clip title next to the time stays at 500, as ruling R1 asks.
- **`studio-theme-obsidian.test.tsx`:** TH10 now expects the new timecode class. A new check also requires the ghost box's class string to appear exactly once and the timecode span to carry `font-normal`. Together they pin the span-level fix rather than the rejected alternative.
- **Doc 125:** status is now "In Progress (awaiting C round 155)". It gains, in Georgian, the C-R154-01 problem and fix, the round-155 test changes, and an updated TODO: V-2b-3 now names the drop-ghost time and the range overlay label, and the css2 trim waits for C's evidence.

**What I ran:**
- **Tests:** the 24 test files (round 154's 21 plus the three ghost-test files) passed 382/382 before and after the edit.
- **Checks:** `npm run typecheck` passes. `npm run lint` passes with its existing 218 warnings. Biome on the two code files is clean.
- **Mutations (the tests fail when the fix is undone):**
  - m141 removes `font-normal` from the timecode: only TH10 fails.
  - m142 removes `font-medium` from the ghost box: only TH10 fails, and only on the new check.
  - Both were restored, and the file hashes match the post-edit hashes.
- **Scope:** HEAD is still `037e25f`. The 970 frozen files are unchanged, and nothing differs from `037e25f` in any protected file. `git status` lists the same 14 paths as at the start.
- **Not run by me:** the full test suite, `verify`, the build, end-to-end tests and every browser row. Those belong to the root gate and C.
- I did not ask for a code review, because the task says it isn't needed for two code files and a doc.

**Still open:**
- C needs to measure the real weight in Chromium (MONO-STYLE-N6), check that no Plex Mono 500 is left on the page, check the cookie banner in the source, and run the smoke rows.
- The two timecodes moved to V-2b-3, the css2 trim and the rest of the backlog are not done.

The report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-155.md`; the test results, mutation runs, end hashes and diff are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-155/`.
